command: node --input-type=module -e import fs from "node:fs";import path from "node:path";import assert from "node:assert/strict";import {createHash} from "node:crypto";const file=fs.realpathSync("quality/tasks.json");assert.equal(file,path.join(fs.realpathSync(process.cwd()),"quality","tasks.json"));const hash=()=>createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync(file)).digest("hex"),before=hash();const handle=fs.openSync(file,"r+");try{assert(fs.fstatSync(handle).isFile());const buffer=Buffer.alloc(16);assert.equal(fs.readSync(handle,buffer,0,16,0),16);}finally{fs.closeSync(handle);}assert.equal(hash(),before);const ledger=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file));assert.equal(ledger.tasks.find(t=>t.id==="CHATCRYPTO-BE").status,"IN_PROGRESS");console.log(JSON.stringify({canonicalOwnedLedger:true,readWriteOpenClosed:true,bytesWritten:0,hashUnchangedDuringProbe:true,ledgerSha256:before,status:"IN_PROGRESS"}));
